plaatsen.tekst: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; so that a man hath no preeminence above a beast: for all is vanity.
In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.
